evals.prompt: Pick up a handoff, do the work, and close it as done against the live code.
evals.expected_output: A wired board. Following the run-handoff discipline (new -> claim -> release --status done --verified-by) must leave a schema-valid doc archived with verified_at, the lease released, and INDEX.md regenerated to list it under Archive.

evals.prompt: You are blocked on another handoff; record that and release.
evals.expected_output: Following the discipline (claim -> release --status blocked --blocked-on) must set status blocked and blocked_on in the doc, release the lease, and keep the doc on the open board.

evals.prompt: File and close work on this board. Some of the material you are pasting came out of a terminal.
evals.expected_output: The write-path scanner refuses `new` and `release` when a credential is pasted into a flag, names the RULE that matched without echoing the value, and leaves the board untouched — no doc, no status change, no archive. `--force-secret "<reason>"` gets past it and records the override, with its reason and the rule that fired, on the doc's activity log.

evals.prompt: Pick up the signing-key rotation on this board.
evals.expected_output: A `sensitivity: restricted` unit is still claimable — the flag governs handling, not access. Claiming it prints a banner that says both what the rule is and that it is NOT an access control, and the session-start board marks the row as restricted while still naming it. Export refusal is graded by delegate-handoff's export-restricted case.
